name: io.github.jpicklyk/task-orchestrator
title: MCP Task Orchestrator
description: Server-enforced workflow discipline for AI agents: work items, dependency graphs, quality gates

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Docker named volume for persistent SQLite data storage, mounted at /app/data

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SQLite database file path (default: data/current-tasks.db)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing .taskorchestrator/config.yaml for workflow schemas (default: working dir)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: stdio (default) or http

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port when using http transport (default: 3001)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR (default: INFO)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional log file path. Unset (default) disables file logging; logs are always JSON on stderr.

environmentVariables.name: API_ALLOW_QUERY_TOKEN_FOR_SSE
environmentVariables.description: Allow ?token= auth for SSE (browser EventSource workaround) (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: API_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED
environmentVariables.description: Confirm flag required alongside API_AUTH_MODE=none (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: API_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: REST API auth mode: bearer, jwks, or none (with API_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=true). Required when API_ENABLED=true

environmentVariables.name: API_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Master REST API switch; set true to register /api/v1/* routes (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_ALGORITHMS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated JWT algorithm allowlist for jwks mode (e.g. RS256,EdDSA)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_ALLOW_INSECURE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Loopback-only opt-in to fetch API_JWKS_URL over plaintext http (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected aud claim value in JWTs (jwks mode)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: JWKS key cache TTL in seconds (default: 300)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Expected iss claim value in JWTs (jwks mode)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_MAX_STALE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Oldest a cached key set may be and still be served after a failed refresh (default: max(3600, TTL))

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted token lifetime in seconds (default: 86400)

environmentVariables.name: API_JWKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint URL (jwks mode); must be https and resolve to public addresses

environmentVariables.name: API_REDACT_NOTE_ATTRIBUTION
environmentVariables.description: Redact actor/verification on notes for non-admin callers (default: true)

environmentVariables.name: API_SSE_AUTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Interval for token-expiry checks on open SSE connections (default: 30)

environmentVariables.name: API_SSE_BUFFER_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Last-Event-ID replay window in event ids (default: 1000; 0 = no replay)

environmentVariables.name: API_TOKENS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the bearer token YAML secret file (default: /run/secrets/api-tokens.yaml)

environmentVariables.name: CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CORS request headers allowlist

environmentVariables.name: CORS_ALLOWED_METHODS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CORS methods allowlist

environmentVariables.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins; empty means no cross-origin access

environmentVariables.name: CORS_EXPOSE_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated response headers browser clients may read

environmentVariables.name: CORS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: CORS preflight cache duration in seconds (default: 3600)

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: SQLite busy timeout for startup paths in milliseconds (default: 5000, floor 100)

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_MAX_CONNECTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Read-pool connection count (default: 10, clamped to 1-64)

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_SHOW_SQL
environmentVariables.description: Log every SQL statement at DEBUG (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: DB_COMPACT_ON_UPGRADE
environmentVariables.description: Run the one-time post-upgrade startup compaction (default: true; false opts out)

environmentVariables.name: FLYWAY_REPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Run Flyway repair and exit (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: FTS_INTEGRITY
environmentVariables.description: FTS5 integrity check at startup: startup (default) or off

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header allowlist extending the loopback defaults (HTTP transport)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED
environmentVariables.description: Opt in to MCP_TRANSPORT=http with API_ENABLED=false, serving /mcp as the local principal (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address when using http transport (default: 0.0.0.0)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SERVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Service name reported in MCP identity and REST service metadata (default: mcp-task-orchestrator-current)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile over stdio: orchestration (default), knowledge, or director

environmentVariables.name: READINESS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Readiness marker file touched once startup succeeds (default: /tmp/mcp-task-orchestrator.ready)

environmentVariables.name: RESOURCE_LEASES_ENFORCED
environmentVariables.description: Deployment-wide kill switch for the resource-lease gate (default: true)

environmentVariables.name: RETENTION_AUDIT_EVENTS_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days to keep audit-class events rows (default: 0 = forever)

environmentVariables.name: RETENTION_CALL_LOG_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days to keep folded call_log rows (default: 90)

environmentVariables.name: RETENTION_EVENTS_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days to keep activity-class events rows (default: 180)

environmentVariables.name: RETENTION_LEASE_HISTORY_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days to keep closed resource_lease_history intervals (default: 365)

environmentVariables.name: SCHEMA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Schema phase: migrate (default) applies pending migrations; validate refuses pending or future versions
